findings.detail: The source reports (42) as commitment fair value, but the extracted holding stores -42000 as cost even though this source table has no cost field.

rationale: Class 1 source-cell review. The flagged AI Titan revolving-loan cost of -42000 exactly matches the filing's (42), in thousands, in the Fair Value column of a commitments schedule whose header is Portfolio Company, Commitment Type, Commitment Expiration Date, Funded Commitment, Commitment, Fair Value. Because the source provides no amortized-cost or cost cell for this row, populating holding cost with the negative commitment fair value is a column-mapping extraction error. Other representative flagged revolving-loan rows show the same source structure, including Accommodations Plus Technologies at table 77 row 26. No aggregate anchor is applicable to this single-column semantic defect.
